correctness.rationale: For odd p, triangularity is unit squareness of 8r+1; the generic classes r≠0,-1/8 mod p contribute p^(k-1)(p-3-chi_p(2)-chi_p(-2))/4 by the exact nonsingular quadratic-character sum. The two singular classes contribute (3+chi_p(-2))/2 times A_{p,k}=1+(p-1)/2 sum_{1≤j≤floor((k-1)/2)}p^(k-2j-1). Even square valuations account for zero and singular lifts, with Hensel preservation elsewhere. Powers of two have a permutation of triangular values and known dyadic square image size (2^(k-1)+(5 or 4))/3. CRT supplies multiplicativity and the separate triangular image sizes, giving all exact nonsquare-excess ratios. Independently directly computed 30 p^k ≤ 10000 for p=2,3,5,7,11,13,17,19,23, all matching, and checked formula for several odd primes and composite interpretations. These are finite corroboration; unrestricted argument is character/valuation/CRT.
